description.value: This OSM record is tagged as a Booster Juice juice bar, but the website linked in the OSM record belongs to Shiny Tea Canada, a Taiwanese Tea Cafe with over 30 years of history specializing in high-quality teas sourced from Taiwan. Shiny Tea operates multiple locations in the Greater Vancouver area and is known for its classic bubble teas and a signature TeaLato — a fusion of Taiwanese tea and Italian gelato. The business currently occupying 15775 Croydon Drive, Unit 103 requires on-the-ground verification.
